title: A Noetherian local ring has finite Krull dimension
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] (a Noetherian commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$). Then its Krull dimension $\dim R$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] is finite: $\dim R$ is an integer $\ge0$ (in particular every chain of prime ideals of $R$ has length at most $\dim R$).
